header: Four things a paper rota cannot do
lead: We built Marlbrook Roster with duty managers. These are the reasons they give their own head office.

items.title: Rules are checked while you plan
items.text: Rest periods, weekly hours, rules for minors and each contract are checked as you place a shift. A plan that breaks a rule cannot be published, and the shift shows why.

items.title: Everyone sees the same published week
items.text: Staff see the published week in the app. Each later change arrives as a notification with the old and the new time. Nobody has to trust a photo of the whiteboard.

items.title: Hours reach payroll already checked
items.text: Clock-ins, approved corrections, absence and premium rates add up to one monthly figure per employee. Your payroll provider gets a file, not a spreadsheet retyped from three others.

items.title: Costs are visible before you commit
items.text: Each draft shows its wage cost against the branch budget and the same week last year. An area manager sees which of 11 sites is over budget while the plan can still change.
